name: Amand Félix Marie Jobbé-Duval

summary.text: Armand Félix Marie Jobbé-Duval was a French painter and politician of Breton origin. He became known for his severely classical compositions, which included the ceiling decorations of many churches and public buildings.
summary.title: Armand Félix Marie Jobbé-Duval
